class.name: OcgTcollectionHasciistring
class.brief_description: A variable-length sequence of ASCII characters (normal 8-bit character type). It provides editing operations with built-in memory management to make HAsciiString objects easier to use than ordinary character arrays. HAsciiString objects are handles to strings. - HAsciiString strings may be shared by several objects. - You may use an AsciiString object to get the actual string. Note: HAsciiString objects use an AsciiString string as a field.
class.description: ! A variable-length sequence of ASCII characters ! (normal 8-bit character type). It provides editing ! operations with built-in memory management to ! make HAsciiString objects easier to use than ordinary character arrays. ! HAsciiString objects are handles to strings. ! - HAsciiString strings may be shared by several objects. ! - You may use an AsciiString object to get the actual string. ! Note: HAsciiString objects use an AsciiString string as a field.

method.name: default
method.description: Initializes a HAsciiString to an empty AsciiString.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Initializes a HAsciiString with a CString.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Initializes a HAsciiString with a single character.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Initializes a HAsciiString with an integer value

method.name: from_5
method.description: Initializes a HAsciiString with a real value

method.name: from_8
method.description: Initializes a HAsciiString with a HAsciiString.

method.name: from_9
method.description: Initializes a HAsciiString with <length> space allocated. and filled with <filler>.This is useful for buffers.

method.name: from_10
method.description: Initializes a HAsciiString with a HExtendedString. If replaceNonAscii is non-null character, it will be used in place of any non-ascii character found in the source string. Otherwise, creates UTF-8 unicode string.

method.name: AssignCat_1
method.description: Appends <other> to me.

method.name: AssignCat_2
method.description: Appends <other> to me. Example: aString = aString + anotherString

method.name: Capitalize
method.description: Converts the first character into its corresponding upper-case character and the other characters into lowercase. Example: before me = "hellO " after me = "Hello "

method.name: Cat_1
method.description: Creates a new string by concatenation of this ASCII string and the other ASCII string. Example: aString = aString + anotherString aString = aString + "Dummy" aString contains "I say " aString = aString + "Hello " + "Dolly" gives "I say Hello Dolly" Warning: To catenate more than one CString, you must put a String before. So the following example is WRONG ! aString = "Hello " + "Dolly" THIS IS NOT ALLOWED This rule is applicable to AssignCat (operator +=) too.

method.name: Cat_2
method.description: Creates a new string by concatenation of this ASCII string and the other ASCII string. Example: aString = aString + anotherString

method.name: Center
method.description: Modifies this ASCII string so that its length becomes equal to Width and the new characters are equal to Filler. New characters are added both at the beginning and at the end of this string. If Width is less than the length of this ASCII string, nothing happens. Example Handle(TCollection_HAsciiString) myAlphabet = new TCollection_HAsciiString ("abcdef"); myAlphabet->Center(9,' '); assert ( !strcmp( myAlphabet->ToCString(), " abcdef ") );

method.name: ChangeAll
method.description: Replaces all characters equal to aChar by NewChar in this ASCII string. The substitution is case sensitive if CaseSensitive is true (default value). If you do not use the default case sensitive option, it does not matter whether aChar is upper-case or not. Example Handle(TCollection_HAsciiString) myMistake = new TCollection_HAsciiString ("Hather"); myMistake->ChangeAll('H','F'); assert ( !strcmp( myMistake->ToCString(), "Father") );

method.name: Clear
method.description: Removes all characters contained in <me>. This produces an empty HAsciiString.

method.name: FirstLocationInSet
method.description: Returns the index of the first character of <me> that is present in <Set>. The search begins to the index FromIndex and ends to the the index ToIndex. Returns zero if failure. Raises an exception if FromIndex or ToIndex is out of range Example: before me = "aabAcAa", S = "Aa", FromIndex = 1, Toindex = 7 after me = "aabAcAa" returns 1

method.name: FirstLocationNotInSet
method.description: Returns the index of the first character of <me> that is not present in the set <Set>. The search begins to the index FromIndex and ends to the the index ToIndex in <me>. Returns zero if failure. Raises an exception if FromIndex or ToIndex is out of range. Example: before me = "aabAcAa", S = "Aa", FromIndex = 1, Toindex = 7 after me = "aabAcAa" returns 3

method.name: Insert_1
method.description: Insert a Character at position <where>. Example: aString contains "hy not ?" aString.Insert(1,'W'); gives "Why not ?" aString contains "Wh" aString.Insert(3,'y'); gives "Why" aString contains "Way" aString.Insert(2,'h'); gives "Why"

method.name: Insert_2
method.description: Insert a HAsciiString at position <where>.

method.name: Insert_3
method.description: Insert a HAsciiString at position <where>.

method.name: InsertAfter
method.description: Inserts the other ASCII string a after a specific index in the string <me> Example: before me = "cde" , Index = 0 , other = "ab" after me = "abcde" , other = "ab"

method.name: InsertBefore
method.description: Inserts the other ASCII string a before a specific index in the string <me> Raises an exception if Index is out of bounds Example: before me = "cde" , Index = 1 , other = "ab" after me = "abcde" , other = "ab"

method.name: IsEmpty
method.description: Returns True if the string <me> contains zero character

method.name: IsLess
method.description: Returns TRUE if <me> is 'ASCII' less than <other>.

method.name: IsGreater
method.description: Returns TRUE if <me> is 'ASCII' greater than <other>.

method.name: IntegerValue
method.description: Converts a HAsciiString containing a numeric expression to an Integer. Example: "215" returns 215.

method.name: IsIntegerValue
method.description: Returns True if the string contains an integer value.

method.name: IsRealValue
method.description: Returns True if the string contains a real value.

method.name: IsAscii
method.description: Returns True if the string contains only ASCII characters between ' ' and '~'. This means no control character and no extended ASCII code.

method.name: IsDifferent
method.description: Returns True if the string S not contains same characters than the string <me>.

method.name: IsSameString_1
method.description: Returns True if the string S contains same characters than the string <me>.

method.name: IsSameString_2
method.description: Returns True if the string S contains same characters than the string <me>.

method.name: LeftAdjust
method.description: Removes all space characters in the beginning of the string

method.name: LeftJustify
method.description: Left justify. Length becomes equal to Width and the new characters are equal to Filler if Width < Length nothing happens Raises an exception if Width is less than zero Example: before me = "abcdef" , Width = 9 , Filler = ' ' after me = "abcdef "

method.name: Length
method.description: Returns number of characters in <me>. This is the same functionality as 'strlen' in C.

method.name: Location_1
method.description: returns an index in the string <me> of the first occurrence of the string S in the string <me> from the starting index FromIndex to the ending index ToIndex returns zero if failure Raises an exception if FromIndex or ToIndex is out of range. Example: before me = "aabAaAa", S = "Aa", FromIndex = 1, ToIndex = 7 after me = "aabAaAa" returns 4

method.name: Location_2
method.description: Returns the index of the nth occurrence of the character C in the string <me> from the starting index FromIndex to the ending index ToIndex. Returns zero if failure. Raises an exception if FromIndex or ToIndex is out of range Example: before me = "aabAa", N = 3, C = 'a', FromIndex = 1, ToIndex = 5 after me = "aabAa" returns 5

method.name: LowerCase
method.description: Converts <me> to its lower-case equivalent.

method.name: Prepend
method.description: Inserts the other string at the beginning of the string <me> Example: before me = "cde" , S = "ab" after me = "abcde" , S = "ab"

method.name: Print
method.description: Prints this string on the stream <astream>.

method.name: RealValue
method.description: Converts a string containing a numeric expression to a Real. Example: "215" returns 215.0. "3.14159267" returns 3.14159267.

method.name: RemoveAll_2
method.description: Remove all the occurrences of the character C in the string Example: before me = "HellLLo", C = 'L' , CaseSensitive = True after me = "Hello"

method.name: RemoveAll_1
method.description: Removes every <what> characters from <me>

method.name: Remove
method.description: Erases <ahowmany> characters from position <where>, <where> included. Example: aString contains "Hello" aString.Erase(2,2) erases 2 characters from position 1 This gives "Hlo".

method.name: RightAdjust
method.description: Removes all space characters at the end of the string.

method.name: RightJustify
method.description: Right justify. Length becomes equal to Width and the new characters are equal to Filler if Width < Length nothing happens Raises an exception if Width is less than zero Example: before me = "abcdef" , Width = 9 , Filler = ' ' after me = " abcdef"

method.name: Search_1
method.description: Searches a CString in <me> from the beginning and returns position of first item <what> matching. It returns -1 if not found. Example: aString contains "Sample single test" aString.Search("le") returns 5

method.name: Search_2
method.description: Searches a String in <me> from the beginning and returns position of first item <what> matching. it returns -1 if not found.

method.name: SearchFromEnd_1
method.description: Searches a CString in a String from the end and returns position of first item <what> matching. It returns -1 if not found. Example: aString contains "Sample single test" aString.SearchFromEnd("le") returns 12

method.name: SearchFromEnd_2
method.description: Searches a HAsciiString in another HAsciiString from the end and returns position of first item <what> matching. It returns -1 if not found.

method.name: SetValue_1
method.description: Replaces one character in the string at position <where>. If <where> is less than zero or greater than the length of <me> an exception is raised. Example: aString contains "Garbake" astring.Replace(6,'g') gives <me> = "Garbage"

method.name: SetValue_2
method.description: Replaces a part of <me> in the string at position <where>. If <where> is less than zero or greater than the length of <me> an exception is raised. Example: aString contains "Garbake" astring.Replace(6,'g') gives <me> = "Garbage"

method.name: SetValue_3
method.description: Replaces a part of <me> by another string.

method.name: Split
method.description: Splits a HAsciiString into two sub-strings. Example: aString contains "abcdefg" aString.Split(3) gives <me> = "abc" and returns "defg"

method.name: SubString
method.description: Creation of a sub-string of the string <me>. The sub-string starts to the index Fromindex and ends to the index ToIndex. Raises an exception if ToIndex or FromIndex is out of bounds Example: before me = "abcdefg", ToIndex=3, FromIndex=6 after me = "abcdefg" returns "cdef"

method.name: ToCString
method.description: Returns pointer to string (char *) This is useful for some casual manipulations Because this "char *" is 'const', you can't modify its contents.

method.name: Token
method.description: Extracts <whichone> token from <me>. By default, the <separators> is set to space and tabulation. By default, the token extracted is the first one (whichone = 1). <separators> contains all separators you need. If no token indexed by <whichone> is found, it returns an empty String. Example: aString contains "This is a message" aString.Token() returns "This" aString.Token(" ",4) returns "message" aString.Token(" ",2) returns "is" aString.Token(" ",9) returns "" Other separators than space character and tabulation are allowed aString contains "1234; test:message , value" aString.Token("; :,",4) returns "value" aString.Token("; :,",2) returns "test"

method.name: Trunc
method.description: Truncates <me> to <ahowmany> characters. Example: me = "Hello Dolly" -> Trunc(3) -> me = "Hel"

method.name: UpperCase
method.description: Converts <me> to its upper-case equivalent.

method.name: UsefullLength
method.description: Length of the string ignoring all spaces (' ') and the control character at the end.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns character at position <where> in <me>. If <where> is less than zero or greater than the length of <me>, an exception is raised. Example: aString contains "Hello" aString.Value(2) returns 'e'
